card.name: Word before 'from the concomitant use'
card.fires_on: Mainly the word 'result' in the opioid boxed warning 'coma, and death may result from the concomitant use of'. Weaker hits appear on scattered words in other label text.

modes.label: Boxed warning 'may result'
modes.description: The word 'result' after 'coma, and death may' in the benzodiazepine/CNS depressant warning.
modes.example: Profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death may<< result>> from the concomitant use of Morph

modes.label: Scattered label words
modes.description: Isolated words inside dosing or storage sentences, with no shared theme.
modes.example: If refrigerated, allow the diluted solution<< to>> come to room temperature prior to administration.
